explicit_limits: This profile is SwiftPM-only and does not imply Xcode project/workspace, Apple platform, SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, Objective-C bridging, or other framework support.
SwiftSyntax is not bundled by the observed toolchain and must not be claimed; bounded syntax facts may use successful swiftc typecheck and compiler AST output only.

SourceKit-LSP has no usable version probe here, and indexed semantic facts require a successful recent SwiftPM build plus target-level failure inspection; process exit zero alone does not prove a complete mixed-target result.
Command Line Tools lacks usable XCTest and Testing modules, so the pilot verifies an executable smoke product and does not claim a native Swift test-module boundary.

Swift interfaces, macros, plugins, resources, generated-source pipelines, arbitrary remote dependencies, mixed Swift/C-family targets, conditional compilation, reflection, and dynamic dispatch remain unsupported until separately validated.
